_comment: Copy to benchmark/samples.local.json (git-ignored) and point it at folders on your machine.
Paths may use ~ and environment variables such as %APPDATA% or $HOME.
named: public samples reported by name in committed results; all of them are used for tuning.
needs_human: samples whose status is undecided; reported separately, never counted as legitimate or malicious.
local: everything else on the machine; reported only as group totals in committed results, and split
deterministically into a tuning half and a held-back half that is not looked at while tuning.
